Affordable Housing Program at Avalon West Chelsea

One-bedroom, two-bedroom and three-bedroom rentals available through the affordable housing program for qualifying future residents at Avalon at Lexington

50% PROGRAM

STUDIO: $1,321 PER MONTH*
1 person household $56,700
2 personal household $64,800

Households must be within the income levels above to qualify.

60% PROGRAM

STUDIO: $1,605 PER MONTH*
1 person household $68,040
2 person household $77,760
ONE-BEDROOM: $1,713 PER MONTH*
1 person household $68,040
2 person household $77,760
3 person household $87,480

Households must be within the income levels above to qualify.

Avalon West Chelsea residents are responsible for electric, phone, and cable utilities. Additional monthly fees apply for premium parking, fitness center, storage, and pets. An increased security deposit will be required for households and pets.

Housing Choice Vouchers encouraged to apply.

*Rents subject to change at anytime without notice. Apartment
